config.title: Commit Wizard
setting.scopes.items.properties.descript: A short explanation of when to use this scope.
setting.scopes.description: Project-specific scopes offered in the scope dropdown, each with a short description.
setting.types.items.properties.descripti: Short explanation shown in the dropdown.
setting.types.items.properties.emoji.des: Gitmoji preselected when this type is picked.
setting.types.description: Commit types offered in the Type dropdown. Empty uses the built-in ten types. Overridden by .commit-wizard.json.
setting.emojis.description: Prefix commit messages with a Gitmoji. When disabled, the Gitmoji dropdown is hidden. Overridden by .commit-wizard.json.
setting.protectedBranches.description: Branch names or globs on which committing asks for confirmation. Overridden by .commit-wizard.json.
setting.ai.enabled.description: Offer a "Draft with AI" button that sends the staged diff (after you confirm) to a language model you choose in VS Code. Off by default; this setting is never read from .commit-wizard.json.
setting.issueTracker.preset.description: Issue tracker preset: detects ticket keys in branch names and links them. Overridden by .commit-wizard.json.
setting.issueTracker.baseUrl.description: Root URL of the tracker (e.g. https://example.atlassian.net), needed to link Jira and Linear tickets.
setting.issueUrlTemplate.description: URL linking a reference to its ticket, with an {id} placeholder. Overrides the tracker preset.
setting.branchPattern.description: Pattern of the New Branch command ({type}, {issue}, {slug}). Empty uses {type}/{issue}-{slug}.
setting.issuePattern.description: Regular expression used to detect the issue in the branch name (first capture group, or the whole match). Empty uses the built-in detection.
setting.emojiPosition.description: Where the Gitmoji goes in the header: before the type ("✨ feat: x") or after the colon ("feat: ✨ x"). Use "after" with Release Please, which only reads headers that start with the type. Overridden by .commit-wizard.json.
setting.history.count.description: Number of latest commits shown in the Commit History view.
setting.history.merges.description: Merge commits in the Commit History view: ignore them, or list them with a merge icon.
setting.telemetry.endpoint.markdownDescr: HTTPS URL receiving anonymous usage events as JSON. Empty (default): events are only written to the *Commit Wizard Telemetry* output channel and nothing is sent. Nothing is reported at all when VS Code telemetry is turned off (`telemetry.telemetryLevel`).
setting.titleWarningLength.description: Character count at which the title shows a soft warning.
setting.titleMaxLength.description: Character count at which the title shows a hard warning.
